_comment: web_clipper_diff assertions reference real fixtures/expected/*.md files — actual Obsidian Web Clipper output, kept under their real derived titles (not a generic {{type}}-expected.md name) since filename derivation is itself part of what filename_equals verifies.

test_cases.prompt: clip this article for me https://nervegna.substack.com/p/claude-code-for-designers-a-practical
test_cases.expected_output: Fetches the URL, climbs the extraction ladder for author/published/description, writes a frozen Resource file with type: article in frontmatter, filename derived verbatim from the title (per config.json's filenames.resource), reports the file path.

assertions.expected_filename: Claude Code for Designers A Practical Guide.md

assertions.expected_file: fixtures/expected/Claude Code for Designers A Practical Guide.md

test_cases.prompt: clip this for me https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cjrv77gl4deo
test_cases.expected_output: Fetches the URL, resolves author/published/publisher via the extraction ladder, writes a frozen Resource file with type: news and a publisher field in frontmatter, filename derived verbatim from the title, body as verbatim {{content}} per the News template's bare-variable body.

assertions.expected_filename: Israeli settlers set fire to mosques, cars and farm land in West Bank, Palestinians say.md

assertions.expected_file: fixtures/expected/Israeli settlers set fire to mosques, cars and farm land in West Bank, Palestinians say.md

test_cases.prompt: clip this thread for me https://www.threads.com/@zudoplatov/post/DbPViUDEahD?hl=en
test_cases.expected_output: Detects the URL as a Social/Forum thread, writes a frozen Resource file with type: social, bare root_post plus the author's own continuation replies (not other participants' replies), author as display name falling back to handle.
test_cases._no_web_clipper_diff: Real Obsidian Web Clipper has no concept matching continuation (author's own reply-chain) — only single-post text extraction, no schema.org on X/Twitter or Threads. No fair comparison possible; verified by mechanical assertions only.

test_cases.prompt: clip this thread for me https://x.com/Aiwithpoonam/status/2081330831961039108
test_cases.expected_output: Detects the URL as a Social/Forum thread (X/Twitter), writes a frozen Resource file with type: social, bare root_post plus the author's own continuation replies (not other participants' replies), author as display name falling back to handle.
test_cases._no_web_clipper_diff: Real Obsidian Web Clipper has no concept matching continuation (author's own reply-chain) — only single-post text extraction, no schema.org on X/Twitter. No fair comparison possible; verified by mechanical assertions only.

test_cases.prompt: clip this youtube video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V-jd3v9P-Ps&t=1185s
test_cases.expected_output: Pulls the transcript via youtube-transcript-api (not the extraction ladder), writes a frozen Resource file with type: video, bare transcript, author as the channel name, filename derived verbatim from the title.

assertions.expected_filename: How Anthropic, Every, & Ramp design with AI.md

assertions.expected_file: fixtures/expected/How Anthropic, Every, & Ramp design with AI.md

test_cases.prompt: clip this thread for me https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1v73ep8/unpopular_opinion_messy_unstructured_prompts_give/
test_cases.expected_output: Detects the URL as a Reddit thread (Social/Forum), no conflict since no user-stated type disagrees, writes a frozen Resource file with type: social, bare root_post plus continuation (the OP's own comment replies, not other participants'), author as the OP's username.
test_cases._no_web_clipper_diff: Same continuation-gap reasoning as the other two Social cases — no fair comparison possible.
test_cases._note: Reddit chosen because it's the one Social-shaped platform proven anonymously fetchable (clip-resource-pilot-run-findings.md, Finding 3) — Threads and X both gate full thread content behind a login wall.

test_cases.prompt: clip https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1v73ep8/unpopular_opinion_messy_unstructured_prompts_give/, I think it's an article
test_cases.expected_output: Detects the URL is a Reddit thread, notices the conflict with the user's stated type, flags it before writing rather than silently picking either side.

test_cases.prompt: clip this youtube video: https://youtube.com/watch?v=abc123, it has no captions at all
test_cases.expected_output: Attempts youtube-transcript-api, gets NoTranscriptFound or TranscriptsDisabled, reports a clean failure and writes nothing — does not attempt any workaround.

test_cases.prompt: clip this article for me https://example.com/some-post
test_cases.expected_output: Stops before fetching anything, tells the user to run setup-slipbox first, and does not write any file or improvise conventions in .slipbox/AGENTS.md's absence — regardless of whether the vault has no .slipbox/ at all, has one with a partial set of artifacts, or has an interrupted setup that never reached the final AGENTS.md write. clip-resource only ever checks for .slipbox/AGENTS.md's presence, since setup-slipbox writes that file strictly last, so all three states are equivalent from its point of view.

test_cases.prompt: clip these for me: https://nervegna.substack.com/p/claude-code-for-designers-a-practical and https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cjrv77gl4deo and https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V-jd3v9P-Ps
test_cases.expected_output: Accepts all three URLs from the one request, runs the fetch/extract/transform/write pipeline independently per URL (one subagent per URL where the harness supports it, sequential fall-back where it does not), writes three separate frozen Resource files with types article, news, and video, and reports the batch as a single table — never three stacked single-URL cards, and no closing question after it.
test_cases._note: Covers the multi-URL fan-out added to Step 1 in the writing-for-agents cleanup. The three URLs reuse fixtures already present for the single-URL article, news, and video cases, so no new fixture is needed.

test_cases.prompt: clip both of these: https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cjrv77gl4deo and https://youtube.com/watch?v=abc123 (that second one has no captions)
test_cases.expected_output: Processes both URLs independently — the news URL succeeds and writes a Resource, the captionless video fails cleanly and writes nothing. One URL's failure never aborts the other's pipeline. Reports both rows in the same batch table, the failed row carrying its own reason, and writes no file for the failure.
test_cases._note: Edge case for the multi-URL fan-out: partial failure. Verifies per-URL isolation and that the batch table reports mixed outcomes rather than collapsing to a single overall verdict.

test_cases.prompt: A configured Article template uses a quoted instruction to rewrite {{content}}. Clip the URL and run the required pre-write checks.
test_cases.expected_output: Invokes /write-checks explicitly in Resource mode for the synthesized Resource body, running Style and Humanize only. It does not invoke note validate; bare-variable capture behavior remains unchanged.

test_cases.prompt: clip this thread for me https://www.threads.net/@zudoplatov/post/DbPViUDEahD, and TinyFish is not available in this session
test_cases.expected_output: Reaches for TinyFish first for the Social fetch, finds it unavailable, and falls back to Firecrawl rather than stopping — Social clipping still fully functions Firecrawl-only. Writes a frozen Resource with type: social. Never attempts to install TinyFish itself, and never tells the user to install it as a CLI or library, since it is MCP-based and has no local install step.
test_cases._no_web_clipper_diff: Same continuation-gap reasoning as the other Social cases — no fair comparison possible.
test_cases._note: Covers the TinyFish-first / Firecrawl-fallback fetch ladder added to references/extract-social.md, and the detect-and-report-only treatment of TinyFish in setup-slipbox. Threads is the platform TinyFish is the only option for, which makes it the case where the fallback matters most.

test_cases.prompt: Clip this article, but I may need to resume if the run is interrupted: https://example.com/recoverable
test_cases.expected_output: Starts independent Resource work with activity clip, checkpoints manifest.json and extraction.json, resolves the template into draft.md, and publishes a frozen create-only target with the shared engine /using-slipbox. It does not write the Resource directly.

test_cases.prompt: Clip https://example.com/fails even if fetching or the transcript fails; I want to be able to inspect or resume it later.
test_cases.expected_output: Persists the failed extraction and failure details in Resource work state, reports failure, and publishes no partial Resource. The work remains resumable or explicitly discardable.

test_cases.prompt: The Article template only uses bare variables. Clip https://example.com/bare and preserve the draft transaction.
test_cases.expected_output: Resolves bare variables into draft.md and publishes through the same Resource transaction; it skips /write-checks because no quoted synthesis instruction ran, but never direct-writes the final target.

test_cases.prompt: A configured Article template contains a quoted rewrite instruction. Clip https://example.com/synthesized and run the pre-write checks.
test_cases.expected_output: Stages the synthesized draft and invokes /write-checks with artifact-kind: resource before publication. Resource checks run Style and Humanize only; field resolution, zone placement, and note validate are not invoked.

test_cases.prompt: Clip https://example.com/already-exists where the configured Resource target already exists.
test_cases.expected_output: Stages the candidate but rejects the target collision without replacing the existing file; the work remains inspectable and is not reported as success.

test_cases.prompt: Resume the interrupted Resource clip for https://example.com/resume, or discard it if the source fingerprint no longer matches.
test_cases.expected_output: Inspects the preserved work, compares fingerprints before resuming, and offers explicit discard for stale work; it never overwrites a changed or frozen target.

test_cases.prompt: Clip these independently: https://example.com/one and https://example.com/two. One may fail.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates independent Resource work directories and commit boundaries, so one URL's extraction or publication failure does not affect the other. Reports one result row per URL.

test_cases.prompt: Finish an extracted Article clip whose staged draft is complete and whose resolved filename is Developing Taste.md. The vault configuration has paths.resources set to Library/Source Material. The invocation supplies no destination folder. Publish the clip through the normal workflow.
test_cases.expected_output: Reads paths.resources through the installed CLI, decodes its JSON string, and uses Library/Source Material/Developing Taste.md consistently as the work target, mutation path, and reported saved path. Adds neither .slipbox nor an article subfolder.

test_cases.prompt: A clip has extraction.json and draft.md preserved, but config get paths.resources reports a missing setting. Finish publishing it.
test_cases.expected_output: Preserves the staged files, reports the missing configuration, and stops before publication without guessing Resources or resources/article as a fallback.
